Pelo valor cobrado essa função deveria ser muito melhor. Só não preço devolução do valor pq não estornam o pagamento.

Apps nativos tanto do Instagram quanto TikTok conseguem entregar melhor definição, não vale o preço!

reviews.title: Péssimo  e trava demais
reviews.text:
Infelizmente Comprei a assinatura deste aplicativo acreditando que teria um período de teste de 3 dias. Porém, já no primeiro dia o aplicativo apresentou muitos travamentos, tornando impossível utilizá-lo. Por esse motivo, solicitei o cancelamento imediatamente.

Para minha surpresa, o reembolso foi negado. A única resposta que recebi foi que a renovação automática foi cancelada para o próximo ano, mas isso não resolve o problema, já que paguei por um serviço que não funcionou adequadamente e cancelei dentro do período de teste.

Fica o alerta para outros usuários: se você não tiver certeza de que vai continuar usando este aplicativo, pense duas vezes antes de assinar. Além de apresentar muitos travamentos, a política de reembolso não corresponde à expectativa criada pelo período de teste, e mesmo cancelando logo no início, o valor não é devolvido.

O App anuncia que você pode testar todas as funcionalidades por um período e quando você assina para testar, não dá a opção de cancelamento!

Não caiam nesse golpe!

Fiz uma reclamação para a APPLE pois quero meu dinheiro de volta!!!

reviews.title: Cobrando 2x a anuidade
reviews.text: Eu já paguei a mensalidade e agora para salvar o vídeo estão cobrando nova mensalidade para ter a versão “pro”! Um absurdo é abuso do cliente

reviews.title: Do not download
reviews.text: App immediately charges you $30 even though it says it's in the free trial. Do not use this.

reviews.title: Trying to charge me twice
reviews.text: I purchased the first year of VILO in August.  Now when I go open, it is trying to start me up with a free trial. And to start over again.  It started on March 4.   With five months left, they’re trying to charge me again.   This is a flaw on the software. Aggravating and now I’m gonna have to go use a different software. Because there’s nobody to contact nobody to fix it.

reviews.title: Ajuda
reviews.text: Estou pagando a um mês esse aplicativo semanalmente e agora que quero fazer o vídeo tá me pedindo de novo pra fazer assinatura ?????

reviews.title: Cobrança indevida
reviews.text: Eu fiz o plano anual em janeiro desse ano, ontem precisei usar o aplicativo e pediu para pagar novamente, sendo que meu plano vence só em janeiro de 2027. Tive que pagar pq precisava do vídeo, porém fiquei muito aborrecido e insatisfeito com o ocorrido.

reviews.title: Slow, glitchy and keeps telling me i don’t have PRO when i do
reviews.text: This app has given me so many headaches, taking hours to save a 2 minute video when i have enough storage.   After 3 attempts today of recording, none have saved as they are taking over an hour. Its now telling me to upgrade to pro version when i already have it. Don’t waster your money.

reviews.title: No support
reviews.text: Paid for a full year suddenly all filters and background options are gone and no way to report the issue.

reviews.title: Péssimo!
reviews.text: Eu estava apenas olhando os planos disponíveis, e o app efetuou a assinatura do plano anual, eu quero o meu reembolso por gentileza!

reviews.title: Preciso de reembolso, não fiz assinatura desse app
reviews.text: Não fiz a assinatura e foi me cobrado 49,90

reviews.title: Free trail cost me
reviews.text: Be careful if you click on free trail! I did but it took £49.99 out of my bank for a year subscription!

reviews.title: Deceptive Marketing/ Glitchy and does not save
reviews.text: I attempted to try this app for work, under the pretense of a FREE TRIAL. I used the app, recordings did not save, I deleted the app and “unsubscribed” less that 6 hours later. I then see a charge for a $74 annual subscription attached to my personal card (had I liked the product, I would’ve charged to a business card) I would not recommend.

reviews.title: DO NOT DOWNLOAD
reviews.text:
Do not download this app. DO NOT DOWNLOAD IT! Find another teleprompter if you need one. They offered me a 2 week free trial period and said they would notify me before it was up before I got charged. I started my trial on February 17th. Cancelled it in Apple settings on the 24th, and got charged on the 27th. Does that make any sense?

This app is predatory and scammy and Apple will not issue a refund no matter how many people you talk to. 

Report this app on the App Store please. Developer, when you read this, eat my shorts, I hope you needed that $12 you scammer.

reviews.title: Terrible decision
reviews.text: Would not recommend to anybody they stole my money and won’t refund it

reviews.title: Audio Not Working Properly
reviews.text: Sometimes the microphone records fine, sometimes there is no sound at all. Very inconsistent performance.

reviews.title: Caution FRAUD DONT USE
reviews.text: They offered a Free Trial option, but once I clicked on Free Trial, it automatically charged my card.  When I looked for their contact info to notify them of the error, there was nothing that worked.  DO NOT TRUST THIS APP. ITS FRAUDULENT.  They take people’s money and the app doesn’t work.

reviews.title: Cachê
reviews.text: Vocês precisam colocar uma opção para limpar cachê dentro do app, mesmo apagando toda os roteiro fica ocupando memória, gravei uns 10 vídeos e mesmo apagando estava utilizando 20 gb de memória!!!!!

reviews.title: Precisa melhorar
reviews.text: A velocidade máxima é lenta, horrível para gravar algo que precisa de agilidade na fala, não recomendo!

reviews.title: Cancelamento
reviews.text: Comprei o plano para testar e usei 10 minutos. Estou há 40 minutos tentando cancelar e não encontro. Nos links que eles enviam, a página dá erro.

reviews.title: Fui enganada.
reviews.text: Cobrança indevida, não respondem, não fazem reembolso! Golpe

reviews.title: Deceptive free trial and renewal
reviews.text: They claimed free 3 day trial with 24 notification before renewal. No notification before they automatically charged me and the App Store refuses refunds even on the same day as the charge. Furthermore the app itself is nothing special and isn’t even as good as other apps that charge half as much

reviews.title: Velocidade script
reviews.text: Péssimo este aplicativo. 8 ou 80 para o ajuste da velocidade em que passa o script!

reviews.title: Suporte - Cobrança Indevida
reviews.text: Estou tentando entrar em contato com o suporte por aqui e está dando erro. Eu baixei o aplicativo, vi que era pago e deletei antes mesmo do período de teste acabar e nem utilizei, não gravei nenhum vídeo e cobrou no meu cartão de crédito o plano anual de R$299,90. Preciso do reembolso!

reviews.title: Help
reviews.text: I need help - I purchased the subtraction and then tried to make videos and it thinks I don’t have a subscription so I cannot use the app. Can someone either help or give me a refund?

reviews.title: Péssimo!
reviews.text:
Teria tudo pra ser maravilhoso, infelizmente não funciona. 
Estou tendo que regravar minhas aulas 3, 4 vezes porque ele simplesmente perde TODO o conteúdo gravado. Desgastante e frustrante. Não comprem.

reviews.title: Horrible! Don’t Purchase
reviews.text:
Review date 01/15/26
It worked the first and second time and that was it, whenever I record a video, it takes hours to save. Most of the time, it refuses to save. I tried recording last night at 10pm, the app got stuck on “ processing “ until 6am this morning when I finally did a force close and lost my video. This app has not been the best for me and I will not recommend it. Also I was charged twice one week apart. I could not get my second payment back after trying multiple times. And when you reach out to customer service it takes several days and they come back with absolutely no help. Not good.

reviews.title: Charged before trial ended
reviews.text: They say you get a 3 day trial, but I was charged not even 6 hours after signing up. Do not trust.

reviews.title: Overpriced for what it does
reviews.text:
UPDATED!!!

$12/week or almost $80 a year for something that scrolls text on your screen???  Hard pass!

UPDATE:  today is January 21, 2026 and I just now got this cookie cutter response from the developer:

"Thanks for using our app and sharing your thoughts. We’re sorry to hear about your experience. If you'd like to share more details so we can better understand and improve, please reach out to us at https://… We appreciate your feedback!"

A cookie cutter response.  Obviously they can’t even take the time to read the comments or they would have already understood and improved!  Your app just prints text on the screen. It’s not worth the money you’re asking. It’s maybe a one time purchase of $9.99 at best.

reviews.title: COBRANÇA ABUSIVA
reviews.text:
Não existe versão teste gratuito. Assim que vc aceita acreditando estar em um ambiente seguro, eles nem lhe cadastram nem nada, já cobra de seu cartão! Fiz solicitação pelo suporte! Até agora nenhuma resposta.
Enganação pura! Deveria ser banido das plataformas de aplicativos da Apple e Android.

reviews.title: Teleprompter too slow.
reviews.text: I was already leery because $12 a week is an outlandish price for any subscription. But I have it a shot because if it was a quality product I would have likely kept it. Unfortunately the teleprompter is extremely slow. You can adjust the speed but even at the highest speed it doesn’t keep up with my normal vocal cadence. This one is a NO from me, dawg.

reviews.title: Took my money
reviews.text: I tried to use once and it wasn’t that easy so immediately canceled the trial. Wanted to try again because it seems none are terribly easy to use so I went to try again and even though I was offered a trial and accepted the trial it charged me immediately. Apple wouldn’t refund.

reviews.title: Scam. Charged me 69.99 when I clicked on 1.35 per week plan
reviews.text: Bought 1.35 per week and it charged me nearly 69.99 dollars for the year. When I went to cancel the subscription I did not get a refund despite not having the app for more than 24 hours. This is ridiculous especially as the plan that I clicked on was advertised for $1.35 a week “no commitment, cancel anytime” which one would obviously think that would go towards 1.35 per week. I want a refund.

reviews.title: not worth it, they’re all fake reviews
reviews.text:
the most important feature that they should have, they don’t have. you can’t have the words scroll while you’re using other apps or on your own camera. 

that’s literally the whole point of this type of app and you don’t even have it.

reviews.title: Audio lagging
reviews.text: The video and the audio don’t match and it’s really annoying. Especially if I use a microphone. The new touch up features are ok, the lipstick looks fake and crazy and the foundation a little much with not a lot of tone changes. Videos often save with a black border if I redo a video more than once without restarting an app. For something I pay for yearly, it’s a bit of a flop. Please fix this.
